sloka: एष वै कैटभस्यार्थे मधुनश्च महाशरः ।सृष्टो महात्मना तेन वधार्थे दैत्ययोस्तयोः ।। ७.६९.२७ ॥
transliteration: eṣa vai kaiṭabhasyārthe madhunaśca mahāśaraḥ ।sṛṣṭo mahātmanā tena vadhārthe daityayostayoḥ ।। 7.69.27 ॥

translations.english: This great arrow was indeed created by that great-souled one for the purpose of killing those two demons, Kaitabha and Madhu.
